commands: yarn run openapi-generator-cli generate --git-repo-id=cogbox --git-user-id=cognifyi -i dist/apps/api/openapi.json -g python -t hack/python-client/openapi-templates --additional-properties=packageName=cogbox_api_client,projectName=cogbox_api_client,packageVersion=$DEFAULT_PACKAGE_VERSION,pythonPackageName=cogbox_api_client,disallowAdditionalPropertiesIfNotPresent=false,enumUnknownDefaultCase=true -o {projectRoot}

VER=${PYPI_PKG_VERSION#v}; if pip download cogbox_api_client==$VER -q -d /tmp 2>/dev/null; then echo "cogbox_api_client==$VER already on PyPI, skipping publish"; else poetry publish --username __token__ --password $PYPI_TOKEN --no-interaction; fi

for i in $(seq 1 20); do if pip download cogbox_api_client==${PYPI_PKG_VERSION} -q -d /tmp; then echo "cogbox_api_client==${PYPI_PKG_VERSION} is now downloadable from PyPI" && sleep 5 && exit 0; else printf '.
' && sleep 5; fi; done; echo "Timeout waiting for cogbox_api_client==${PYPI_PKG_VERSION} on PyPI" >&2; exit 1
